## 型

### Set

```emela
opaque type Set[A]
```

A set of values of type `A`, ordered by Ord.

## 値

### empty

```emela
fn empty[A]() -> Set[A]
```

The empty set.

### from_list

```emela
fn from_list[A: Ord](xs: List[A]) -> Set[A]
```

The set of the values of `xs`.

### insert

```emela
fn insert[A: Ord](s: Set[A], x: A) -> Set[A]
```

`s` with `x`.

### remove

```emela
fn remove[A: Ord](s: Set[A], x: A) -> Set[A]
```

`s` without `x`.

### contains

```emela
fn contains[A: Ord](s: Set[A], x: A) -> Bool
```

Whether `x` is in `s`.

### size

```emela
fn size[A](s: Set[A]) -> Int
```

The number of values.

### is_empty

```emela
fn is_empty[A](s: Set[A]) -> Bool
```

### fold

```emela
fn fold[A, B](s: Set[A], from: B, f: fn(B, A) -> B fails E(f) uses { R(f) }) -> B fails E(f) uses { R(f) }
```

Folds the values in order, starting from `from`.

### each

```emela
fn each[A](s: Set[A], f: fn(A) -> () fails E(f) uses { R(f) }) -> () fails E(f) uses { R(f) }
```

Calls `f` on each value in order. Stops at the first failure.

### to_list

```emela
fn to_list[A](s: Set[A]) -> List[A]
```

The values in order.

### filter

```emela
fn filter[A](s: Set[A], f: fn(A) -> Bool fails E(f) uses { R(f) }) -> Set[A] fails E(f) uses { R(f) }
```

The values for which `f` is True.

### union

```emela
fn union[A: Ord](a: Set[A], b: Set[A]) -> Set[A]
```

The values of both.
